name: IZSetIsa
doc: The core Z-set/Quantum ISA interface representing the 6 primary operations: Fold, Emit, Retract, Branch, Join, and Merge.

members.name: Emit
members.doc: Ry rotation raising k's amplitude. Weight +1. Unitary.

members.name: Retract
members.doc: Adjoint EMIT. Weight -1. EMIT then RETRACT = I. Unitary.

members.name: Branch
members.doc: H gate. Superposition (both states coexist while tick open). Unitary.

members.name: Merge
members.doc: Superposition-merge. Amplitudes interfere. Stays in soft space.

members.name: Fold
members.doc: Repeated MERGE. Executes the replay loop that reconstructs Yin/Yang cell states.

laws.doc: Emit then Retract on same qubit restores state to identity.
Branch (Hadamard) is self-adjoint: Branch then Branch = Identity.
